records.quote: at the end of the month
records.text: Well, after I receive the customer's quotation request, I check the customer information in the CRM. Then I create the quotation document in the quoting system using the pricing information. From there, if the quotation amount is over 1,000,000 yen, the manager has to approve the high-value quotation for credit risk management. After that approval, I send the quotation to the customer via email. However, if the amount is at or below 1,000,000 yen, I can send the quotation to the customer directly. Also, at the end of the month, I send the month-end summary of quotation information to Accounting using Excel.
